text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Minister of state for cabinet affairs says government to take serious measures to end unemployment soon.

- Kuwait bans stateless people holding Kuwaiti passports form leaving the country after 10 asked for asylum in Britain. Kuwait says it grants some of the stateless people special passports for humanitarian reasons.
- Official at Beirut Stock Exchange says Kuwait, Lebanon, Egypt bourses to link up on January 6.

- Meeting of the Kuwaiti-Syrian ministerial committee, held on Monday in Syria to discuss economic cooperation, was a success, Kuwait's Finance Minister Nasser al-Rodhan, who represented Kuwait at the meeting, said.
- General Manager of Kuwait Fund for Arab Development Bader al-Humeizi says fund is ready to finance development projects in Lebanon worth $100 million in the coming five years.
- Kuwait Internaitonal Investment Company preparing to set up two Islamic insurance companies in Kuwait and Oman, company official says.
- Kuwait National Petroleum Company to conduct an emergency drill at Ahmadi refinery on Sunday.
- Cabinet endorses draft bill ammending a labour law article.
